# Regulatory Compliance and AML Control Updates

This document outlines urgent actions required within the Risk & Compliance department based on recent audit findings and ongoing regulatory monitoring needs.

## Key Action Items:

*   Update internal controls based on audit recommendations.
*   Monitor regulatory changes urgently to ensure continuous compliance.
*   Review AML detection mechanisms based on audit findings.
*   Update AML detection systems urgently.
*   Review legal risks urgently to mitigate potential exposures.
